scope: MOT2 motor controller GET (function 0x08) index map, static analysis only
method: Ghidra decompilation with the project's RISCV:LE:32:QingKe profile (44 LLVM XW vectors validated); no firmware executed, emulated or sent to a controller

handler.response_payload: 4 bytes little-endian, the raw bits of the field (float32 or integer)
handler.cases: 0..18; no default case: an index >= 19 returns the previous answer unchanged
handler.same_in_all_images: indices 0-10 and 15-18 read identical object offsets; 11-14 read system-object fields that moved in 081 (0x6b4/0x69a/0x69e/0x38 -> 0x7bc/0x7a2/0x7a6/0x40)

objects_071_022.registry_crosscheck: spd.kp +0x1c8, spd.ki +0x1cc, spd.kc +0x1d4, cur.kp +0x294, cur.kc +0x2a0, pos.kp +0xfc match base+0x08/+0x0c/+0x14

matrix.name: zero
matrix.source: constant 0 in the handler

tracking_error: not a GET index. The firmware keeps the position PID error at controller+0x124 (used by the stall detector) but the handler does not expose it. ref - fdb from indices 1 and 5 is a host-side approximation from two separate transactions.
